versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), for every requested DID the Dcm module shall check if the DID has a Read access con- figured (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidRead in DcmDspDidInfo ). If none of the DID has a Read access, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x31 (Request out of range).
